Let a user remove a page with Undo (D-06 to D-08) and reorder pages with ▲ ▼ or by dragging the handle, with every page collapsing to its title bar while dragging (D-05). The host gets its full chapter title bar (D-01).

Purpose: CHAR-04 (remove half) and CHAR-05. The snackbar gains an action button, the store gains removePage/restorePage/reorder, and the page becomes a CDK drop list.
Output: extended SnackbarService/SnackbarComponent, store methods, IconComponent, DragHandle, SubDocHost chrome, CharacterPage drop list and undo orchestration, a synthetic test plugin, and the reorder-persist integration spec.
</objective>

  <action>
SnackbarService (additive, keep the single-slot queue):
- `ToastAction { label: string; onClick: () => void }`. Add `action?: ToastAction` to `Toast` and `ShowOptions`.
- `show()` returns the new toast's `id`.
- `dismiss(id?: number)`: with no id, or an id equal to the current toast's id, keep today's logic. With an id of a queued toast, splice it from the queue. Otherwise no-op.
- `runAction()`: read current(). If it has an action, call `action.onClick()`, then `dismiss()`. If onClick itself shows a toast, that toast queues and is presented by the dismiss.

SnackbarComponent:
- After `.toast-message`, `@if (t.action; as action)` renders `<span class="toast-sep" aria-hidden="true">·</span><button type="button" class="toast-action" (click)="runAction()">{{ action.label }}</button>`. `runAction()` delegates to the service.
- SCSS: `.toast-action` is transparent with `--on-accent` text, a 1px `--on-accent` border, `--radius-full`, 600 weight and a 44 px min-height hit area. Hover/focus-visible uses the existing 2px focus ring. The global button hover colours must not turn the label accent-on-accent, so override hover colour to `--on-accent`.

`apps/web/src/app/testing/test-plugins.ts` (test-only; `tsconfig.app.json` lists only main.ts, so it never ships):
- `TestNotesEditor`: standalone, OnPush, selector `cd-test-notes-editor`, implements `SubDocumentEditor<{ body: string }>` with an inline template of one textarea `.test-notes-body` that emits `{ body }` on input.
- `TEST_NOTES_PLUGIN`: schema object with type 'test-notes', displayName 'Test Notes', description 'Synthetic page for multi-page specs', adult false, currentVersion '1.0.0', supportedVersions ['1.0.0'], migrations [], `schema: intimacySchema.schema` cast (never validated in these specs), `createDefault: () => ({ body: '' })`, `collectImageRefs: () => []`. Plugin fields: `load: async () => TestNotesEditor`, icon 'ph-note', printBreakBefore false, no sections.
- `provideTestPlugins()`: returns `{ provide: SUBDOC_PLUGINS, useValue: Object.freeze({ ...PLUGIN_REGISTRY, 'test-notes': TEST_NOTES_PLUGIN }) }`.

CharacterStore (same immutability discipline as updateCore):
- `removePage(type): { page: SubDocument; index: number } | null`: null when no character or the type is absent. Otherwise set a new pages array without it and return the original envelope and its index.
- `restorePage(characterId: string, page: SubDocument, index: number): boolean`: false when no character, when `core.id !== characterId`, when `!Object.hasOwn(this.plugins, page.type)`, when the type is present, or when `pages.length >= PAGES_MAX`. Otherwise insert at `Math.min(index, pages.length)` into a new array, set, and return true.
- `reorder(from: number, to: number): void`: return unless both are integers within `[0, pages.length)` and differ. Otherwise splice into a new array and set with a fresh `updatedAt`. Never add an order or position field (ADR-0003).

Specs:
- `snackbar.service.spec.ts` and a new `snackbar.component.spec.ts` cover the snackbar bullets; use `vi.useFakeTimers()` only in the duration test and restore real timers after.
- `character.store.spec.ts`: add a `describe('CharacterStore remove, restore and reorder')` block using `TestBed.configureTestingModule({ providers: [provideTestPlugins()] })`, seeding a character with both pages through `addPage`. Assert persisted keys on the raw record via `NativeIndexedDBService.getByKey`.
